titulo: They asked for my website and I sent my Instagram
hooks: They asked for my website, I sent Instagram
Is your website just your Instagram?

mensajes.texto: Hi, do you have a website? I want to send it to my boss
Yes, of course. Here's the link
Ok, I'll send you a voice memo and explain
No, that's ok. I'll let you know

contenido.remate: Spoiler: she never reached out again

captions: A big client wants to see your website to show their boss, and you send your Instagram. Some people check it. Others, like Lucy's boss, don't even have an account.
Instagram is great for showing off your work. A website lets people find you on Google, compare you and hire you without you having to send a voice memo.
If your 'website' is your Instagram, you depend on the other person having an account, on your account not getting shut down, and on them finding what they need among all your posts.
